lines.en: : Sorry, but I think I’d rather walk by myself today.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过我今天想自己一个人走。

lines.en: show reina_normal
: Wait, really?
: But we’re both going to the same place.
lines.zh: : 可我们要去的是同一个地方啊。

lines.en: : Am I just like, supposed to awkwardly walk behind you all the way there or something?
lines.zh: : 也就是说，我得一路尴尬地跟在你后面

lines.en: : Isn’t that exactly what you were doing before you called out to me?
lines.zh: : 在你喊我之前，你不正是这么做的吗？

lines.en: show reina_annoyed
: That’s only because I wasn’t sure if it was you or not!
lines.zh: : 那只是因为我当时不确定那是不是你！

lines.en: show reina_normal
: It would have been totally frickin’ weird if I ran up to some random guy and was all like, “Yuu-kun! Long time no see!”
lines.zh: : 要是我冲上去拍某个陌生人的背，那也太他妈奇怪了。

lines.en: : He’d probably think I was some sort of crazy person.
lines.zh: : 他大概会以为我是个疯子。

lines.en: : But you are some sort of crazy person.
lines.zh: : 可你本来就是某种意义上的疯子。

lines.en: show reina_annoyed
: Hey! What the heck is that s’posed to mean?!
lines.zh: : 喂！你这话到底是什么意思？！

lines.en: I turn my back to Reina and set down the path to school once more.
lines.zh: 我背过身去，再次踏上通往学校的路。

lines.en: : Hey, Yuu-kun!
: Ugh. So unfair…
Reina proceeded to awkwardly walk behind me for the rest of the trip.
lines.zh: Reina 就这么尴尬地跟在我身后，走完了剩下的

lines.en: scene black
